title: A focused launcher run whose output contains a nested launcher run's "results:" line is recorded Unknown (path rejected): the host picks the LAST results: line
outcome: For a focused launcher run, the host associates the run with its OWN results.json (the outer launcher's summary), even when the wrapped command's output includes a nested launcher run's summary lines. A nested fixture's later "results:" line can no longer make the host reject the outer run's path and record Unknown. It stays fail-closed: an output with no matching own results path is still Unknown.
acceptance: For a recognized foreground focused launcher Test or Build, the host associates results.json with the outer launcher's first terminal verdict and run id even when later diagnostic output contains a nested launcher's results: line or verdict. Otherwise eligible outer test passes with validated positive counts remain succeeded; outer test/build native failures remain failed, without adopting the nested run's status or counts.

When the matching outer results path is missing, malformed, foreign, mismatched with that verdict, or ambiguously names conflicting artifacts, the host remains Unknown with a named validation reason. A nested run's record is never used as fallback evidence for the outer command.

Existing owner, root/path, invocation/argv, detached-mode, native-exit, interval, input/source, count and outcome guards are not relaxed. Pipe/compound refusal and legacy full/live stage rules remain intact; regression tests cover nested-summary association and ordinary valid and invalid focused records.

Preserve a fail-first witness on unchanged production code at 9d7725fa and passing focused regression evidence after the fix without weakening tests or increasing timeouts. Before completion and landing, the maintained full five-stage gate passes on the exact final carried input, a qualified independent Codex/Claude review pair is recorded, and a fresh independent acceptance evaluation is consumed.
